title: Presynaptic functional organization by phase separation
title_zh: 突触前相分离的功能组织
abstract: Neurons and their synaptic connections harbor numerous and diverse activities through functional organization, thereby enabling nervous system complexity. Within densely packed presynaptic terminals, there exists a mix of molecules, organelles and synaptic vesicles arranged as a set of distinct domains, each with a specific composition that enables discrete functional programs. For example, a subset of synaptic vesicles is made available at the active zone for immediate use, while the vast majority of vesicles are located away from this region and reserved. Likewise, synaptic vesicle recycling and proteolytic processes take place in domains away from the synaptic vesicle cluster. An emerging body of work has established that these functional domains are maintained and regulated by phase separation of molecules, that is, the formation of non-membrane-bound macromolecular condensates. Thus, characterizing the phase separation of molecules and organelles within the presynapse and its role in facilitating robust functional output, diversity and coordination within the presynaptic terminal is crucial for elucidating the vesicle trafficking mechanisms that underlie synaptic transmission. This Review by Ogunmowo and Watanabe summarizes recent findings in the field showing how presynaptic functions are enabled, organized and coordinated by phase separation and discusses future directions in this branch of neuroscience.
abstract_zh: 神经元及其突触连接通过功能组织承载着众多且多样的活动，从而使神经系统具备复杂性。在密集的突触前末梢中，分子、细胞器和突触小泡以一系列不同域的形式排列，每个域具有特定的组成，从而实现离散的功能程序。例如，一部分突触小泡在活跃区可供立即使用，而绝大多数小泡则位于该区域之外并被储备。同样，突触小泡回收和蛋白酶过程发生在远离突触小泡簇的域中。新兴研究已确立，这些功能域由分子的相分离维持和调控，即非膜包被的大分子凝聚体的形成。因此，表征突触前区分子和细胞器的相分离及其在促进突触前末梢内稳健功能输出、多样性和协调性中的作用，对于阐明突触传递的囊泡转运机制至关重要。Ogunmowo 和 Watanabe 的这篇综述总结了该领域的最新发现，展示了突触前功能如何由相分离实现、组织和协调，并讨论了神经科学这一分支的未来方向。
